claim.scope: Finite public Wide root JSON shared ADVANCED v2/CHUNKED v3 with ordinary Nested(n UInt8, s String) and Array(Tuple(n UInt8, s String)), String0/1; paired stock/library reads and library part ATTACH/CHECK plus independent native direct paths.
claim.review_limitation: Luna candidate/static reviews are correlated; root owns actual serial suites, fresh builds, native invocations, independent literals, raw provenance and mutation checks.

boundaries.rollback: Revert only the exact scoped atomic W198 commit; no push or unrelated changes.
boundaries.implementation: No production files changed. Existing W197 Array/implicit named Tuple child adapters compose through public writer/reader. Always-spill SharedVariant is legal; matching stock actual-roster selection is not required.
boundaries.strongest_failure: Self-roundtrip or whole-JSON success hides nominal type loss or an unreadable independent typed path; profile labels conceal wrong persisted layout.
guards: Actual decoded shared_data_version and metadata-bound ordinary String profile authenticated on both origins
Missing versus present-empty and actual persisted PK checked separately
Native full/middle/zero whole/type/direct queries, exact markers, inventory cardinality and process failures
Specialized Nested LC/Variant/Dynamic children and QBit/JSON actual-path guards unchanged
nonclaims: All legal recursive products or nested-within-nested native corpus
Compact advanced parts, arbitrary Dynamic roster or dictionary evolution
Full repository suite, full types, MV/projections, performance or repository-wide class decomposition

external_reference.guard_limits: Root-only serial compiler/native work; 600s, 12288MiB, minimum free memory50%. Native W180 supervisor10s/grace2s, max_threads1, 512MiB per CH process.

identity.encoding: SHA256 over sorted regular nonsymlink src/spec relative path + NUL + per-file SHA256 hex + newline
